analysis.reading: THE ARCHIVE’S SELF-ASSESSMENT IS SURFACED AS A SOURCE. Card 5 is a Ratification Record — an internal Assembly adjudication — and its snippet is the Assembly’s verdict on the archive’s own work: "The No-Floor Theorem is a genuine formal contribution; the symbolon mechanism the most precise account of heteronymic propagation through institutional …". The layer cites the archive’s judgement of itself as evidence about the archive. Card 2 also carries the FNM’s declaration verbatim: "A symbolon is not a summary. It is a provocation to traversal. This document is the first half." The same line the layer misread as a programming request on 12 June is here served correctly.
